description: All frozen qualifying bright stellar entries within 2000 light-years, plus the Sun.

cutoffPolicy: Every frozen SIMBAD stellar entry no farther than 2000 light-years with compiled Johnson V no fainter than Mintaka (V=2.41). The aggregate Alpha Centauri system row is replaced by its qualifying A and B components. Acrux uses the Bright Star Catalogue combined V=0.76. Sun is included only as the map origin.
snapshot: J2000.0; SIMBAD TAP queried 2026-09-25; physical sources frozen 2026-09-25; 82 qualifying bright stars plus Sun.
